title: Bounded in-memory queue with sequential delivery
description: Implement the EventQueue interface from src/queue.ts: bounded FIFO, monotonically increasing seq, ISO receivedAt, rejection with reason full at capacity, and strictly sequential single-consumer delivery into Pi. Deliberately not crash durable: events at restart are lost by design, which is ADR-0001, not a bug. Admission and overflow semantics are what the overload status codes in the listener depend on.
author: Tomislav Zorcec
